stats.note: Measured on train companies against the eight accepted outcomes. Score-fall alerts are about as often followed by those outcomes as an alert on a random month (lift 0.7-1.2): they say a company moved away from its own normal, with the reason and the amount, not that it will fail. The top-customer alert is the one with a measured lift (about 2x). Details: analysis/monitor/evaluation.md.
